scope: Broad empirical fingerprint-retrieval research; no production discovery engine or SDK promotion.
interpretation_rules: Source artifacts overlap. Do not add their row counts as independent samples.
Preserve each cohort's denominator, condition, metric basis, and partial-coverage status.
Candidate-value correctness, node localization, projected values, DOM coordinates, proposal recall, and Contract acceptance are distinct outcomes.
Null metrics remain null, not zero. Per-row scorer latency is not end-to-end discovery cost.
Fresh-page annotations are agent-reviewed from captured source HTML; they are non-blind and are not independent human gold or live DOM evidence.

entries.cohort: Six source captures, ten source-derived cases each; 166320 raw rows per encoder and 162624 after original-seed exclusion.
entries.result: Nineteen distinct methods plus three hybrids; zero scorer exceptions. The reported table's controlled slice is obj-003 through obj-006 (40 cases).
limitations: Repeated field/configuration trials are not independent pages.
Same-shop controlled evidence does not establish cross-site generalization.

entries.cohort: MiniLM and BGE-small baseline bundles.
entries.result: Restored matching reproduced scores, ranks, ownership, and absence metrics exactly; no network or embedding inference. Timings are excluded from equality.
limitations: Replay equality does not reproduce historical cold-start cost.

entries.cohort: Controlled captured pages; MiniLM L6 and L12; three pool budgets and two pool builders.
entries.result: 7141 unique candidate-reference pairs per model. Complete-record accuracy is 0 across the 36 recorded configurations for each model.
limitations: Per-field ranking and pool recall are separate; controlled cases only.

entries.cohort: 84240 rows; fixed seed-supported source projections; model inference calls: 0.
entries.result: Exact comparison: Xenova MiniLM L6, char_ngram_semantic_reference pool budget 5, global/controlled/all fields. Original value ranking returns 57/828 values and 363/828 nodes at top 1; projection-restricted ranking returns 293/828 values/nodes; node-rank-then-project returns 375/828 values and 363/828 nodes. Each policy has 12/12 absent-field false positives.
limitations: Source-projected value wins are not DOM coordinate wins.
Projection reads use seed-supported hints and are counted separately.
Tie handling differs from the earlier reranker; compare only within this campaign.

entries.cohort: Core required {id,name,price} and six required {id,name,price,color,material,stock} flat schemas over the 60 controlled cases.
entries.result: 11400 unique adapter calls; 23760 pre-schema record keys expand to 47520 record/schema links (the manifest field prepared_record_keys stores this schema-expanded total). Record-link statuses: 35948 native_validated, 1952 native_issues, 9620 source_binding_rejected. Selection statuses: 6492 native_validated, 642 native_issues, 4266 source_binding_rejected. Of the validated links, 33698/35948 are native_valid_but_wrong under the experiment's locator/owner/alias comparison, which includes root and optional fields; this is not a semantic value error rate. The installed SDK was Yosoi 0.4.0rc1 from yosoi-surface-evidence.
limitations: This was not a build of the current experiment branch.
The schemas were flat; arbitrary RuntimeContract recursion was not tested.
Gold labels were not supplied as invalidator inputs; they are used after validation for evaluation.
The native valid-but-wrong category includes coordinate/owner/alias mismatches, including roots and optional fields; do not interpret 33698/35948 as a semantic value error rate.
Contract acceptance is not candidate retrieval or visible-page accuracy.

entries.cohort: Twelve fresh, non-blind source-HTML pages; only the QScrape two-reference group.
entries.result: 23520 rows; tree methods emitted 1008 partial events.
limitations: Other reference groups and full tree coverage remain unmeasured.

entries.cohort: Twelve fresh pages across three templates, two encoders, 24 page/model shards, 5824 rows per shard.
entries.result: 139776 raw rows, zero scorer failures. For global context semantic_reference, MiniLM has R@1 1/52 and R@5 7/52; BGE-small has R@1 0/52 and R@5 2/52. Each method row has 52 present, 28 absent, and 4 unavailable trials; both reference methods produce 28/28 absent-field false positives.
limitations: Rows repeat method/configuration trials on the same 12 pages.
References are foreign QScrape references; this does not establish blind generalization.

entries.cohort: Alternate evaluation of the persisted expanded-wave predictions; 52 present-field rows per encoder/method row.
entries.result: MiniLM semantic_reference moves from strict to qualified R@1 1/52 to 3/52 and R@5 7/52 to 9/52. BGE-small moves from 0/52 to 2/52 at R@1 and 2/52 to 5/52 at R@5.
limitations: The reviewer used retained source HTML and candidate context; review was not blind or independent human gold.
No model predictions/rankings were used; canonical labels and retrieval code were unchanged.
Qualified alternatives are a separate scoring contract, not a model improvement.

entries.cohort: 25 fixed channel orders × 5 budgets × 2 encoders; 24 foreign page/model shards and 12 matched same-site page/model shards.
entries.result: On foreign MiniLM, structure-only budget 5 proposes 16/52 present values; lexical+structure budget 10 proposes 18/52; structure+lexical+semantic_reference budget 15 yields 21/52 strict and 23/52 qualified proposal hits. On matched same-site, structure-only budget 5 and structure+lexical+semantic_reference budget 15 both propose all 26/26 present rows with no absent nonempty pools; adding semantic_query at budget 15 still gives 26/26 present but creates nonempty pools on all 14/14 absent rows (408 proposals versus 130 for structure-only). The 28 absent foreign trials receive nonempty pools in this proposal-union analysis.
limitations: This is proposal recall at a candidate budget, not accepted-value accuracy or discovery/Surface benefit.
All channel orders are retained; no order was selected using gold.
Nonempty pools on absent fields expose a false-positive/abstention issue.

entries.cohort: Same six target pages per arm, 69,888 rows per arm, 12 shards per arm, two encoders. The 26 present rows include six root trials; there are 14 absent rows.
entries.result: For shared structural_jaccard, same-site R@1/R@5 is 26/26 and 26/26 versus foreign 2/26 and 8/26; absent false positives are 0/14 versus 14/14. MiniLM semantic_reference: same-site 13/26 and 22/26 versus foreign 0/26 and 4/26. BGE-small semantic_reference: same-site 8/26 and 18/26 versus foreign 0/26 and 1/26. Semantic-reference absent false positives are 0/14 versus 14/14.
limitations: References are manually supplied; one template per host confounds host and template.
The same-site aggregate's 16 incomplete tree scores are budget_exhausted outcomes, not scorer exceptions; selected structural and semantic-reference rows are complete.
Eighteen of 26 audited top decisions have zero score margin, so deterministic ties matter.

entries.cohort: Seventeen one-axis synthetic depth, width, and attribute-count cases.
entries.result: 10 fully measured, 1 with unavailable method, 5 budget/truncation-limited, 1 budget-rejected; 2.919659226 CPU seconds and 2.935498885 wall seconds. No model/browser calls.
limitations: One-axis sweeps only; no Cartesian stress matrix.
RuntimeContract recursion was not tested; synthetic bounds do not prove arbitrary nested optional/multilingual behavior.
Seven cases record method/budget limits; there were no execution stops.

entries.cohort: Twelve retained source HTML pages: eight pages with Product/Offer candidates and four Books pages with no structured Product/Offer metadata.
entries.result: Eight Product and eight Offer candidates. Four microdata raw prices exactly match the manual display string; four JSON-LD offers match typed numeric amount plus explicit GBP. These are eight page-level witnesses across two distinct profiles, not eight DOM-location wins.
limitations: All 12 source extraction attempts completed within the simple profile; this does not mean 12 complete product records.
The operator inspected sample labels before extraction; the extractor inputs themselves remain manifest plus raw HTML only.
The $-prefixed raw prices are not stripped to manufacture typed amounts; availability URIs are not stock quantity/prose.
Source HTML does not prove rendered visibility, freshness, or truth.

entries.cohort: One 16264-string vector artifact per model; all page shards, same-site/foreign comparisons, and proposal analyses reused these artifacts. No per-wave or per-arm embedding inference ran.
entries.result: MiniLM L6 global ledger: 16264 inputs, 7576 cache hits, 8688 newly embedded, 414713 tokens, 272 calls, 212.052754 inference CPU seconds and 214.499504 inference wall seconds; total adapter wall 248.199929 seconds and 251.442075 seconds including artifact write. BGE-small v1.5: 16264 inputs, 3384 cache hits, 12880 newly embedded, 734433 tokens, 403 calls, 952.815044 inference CPU seconds and 958.519098 inference wall seconds; total adapter wall 1008.018482 seconds and 1011.595942 seconds including artifact write.
cost_unknowns: All per-page shard summaries copy the same global preparation ledger; do not add them across shards.
MiniLM includes 4192 verified resumed vectors whose earlier computation cost is unmeasured; 3384 cached strings overlap the original set.
BGE's 3384 cache hits overlap the original set; cached vectors do not incur new inference in these runs.
Inference was local/offline with one CPU thread and $0 direct API charge.
Hardware, electricity, and operator costs are unknown.

entries.cohort: One foreign MiniLM/books-obsession shard; 49 artifacts and 194202422 bytes restored from native Archive.
entries.result: Recomputed 5824 rows with expected quality digest ee30cd6a36d8b88a46c96c5341c53854a0ecd4e6711071dbe5dc406fdf5112df. No embedding inference or runner network operations; scoring_ns is the only excluded field.
limitations: Only one representative shard was archived and replayed; do not claim all expanded waves are archived.

entries.cohort: 51988 result rows referencing eleven source artifacts.
entries.result: 69,144 overlapping table rows from 17 source artifacts, including reference-count and viewport-condition slices.
limitations: Source tables overlap; 51988 is not an independent sample size and rows must not be averaged across unlike cohorts.

entries.cohort: Four original QScrape targets, three cached scorers, projection hints.
entries.result: A small value-shape probe only.
limitations: No cross-site or universal claim.

entries.cohort: 377 URL pairs across ten policies.
entries.result: PSL-pinned and IDNA behavior checked; eligibility only.
limitations: Eligibility is not retrieval quality.

entries.result: 23,520 persisted fresh nonsemantic rows inspected into 1,692 groups with partial-proposal hit rates; locality extension remains unmeasured.
limitations: Do not confuse useful proposals with complete validated outputs or actual Surface cost.

entries.cohort: 72 cases, 13 groups, 4 profiles planned.
limitations: Remaining reference groups and semantic channels remain unmeasured.

entries.cohort: Four source pages captured at 1920x1080 and 390x844, with desktop UA and mobile=false.
entries.result: Eight HTTP 200 captures have stable DOM, geometry/font sidecars and PNGs. Wide/narrow capture wall times 9.038/8.384 s; owned browsers reaped and temporary profiles removed.
limitations: Capture completion is not universal subresource success; Books script and Web Scraper image/Fetch failures are recorded.
Viewport variation is not mobile-device certification.
One narrow stock element is present in DOM but visually occluded by a fixed footer.
New coordinates are source-bound; archived DOM coordinates were not reused.
Context/operation-budget proxies are not actual model-turn savings.

entries.cohort: Owner-reported integrated check on 2026-10-31.
entries.result: 231 tests and 62 subtests passed; Ruff check passed and77files are formatted. Actual installed native SDK0.4.0rc1; no new native branch build.
limitations: Software checks validate implementation, not retrieval quality or production acceptance.
Markup-aware learned encoders and screenshot embeddings remain unmeasured.

entries.cohort: Six held-out same-site pages; 26 present trial rows including six roots. 42 full score vectors compared against 84 saved rows under two encoder tags; these are shared controls, not independent repeats.
limitations: Only permutations within exact-score ties are varied; this is neither held-out accuracy nor confidence calibration.
Per-query worst/best bounds need not be realizable with one global candidate-ID ordering.
Producer and tests retained with measurement hashes before later format/bootstrap cleanup.
Retained scorer pass took 6.077 CPU / 6.119 wall seconds; earlier failed-attempt overhead was not aggregated.

entries.cohort: Four source pages, two viewports, three field roles. 33 present/3 absent directed cross-template trials per condition; 11 present/1 absent same-page trials.
limitations: Four non-blind, previously inspected shop/demo pages; not independent human gold or 33 independent products.
DOM node localization is distinct from visibility, value projection, acceptance and Surface steps.
No weights were fitted. All fixed layout profiles and controls retained; exploratory maxima are not a deployed choice.
Source-role alternatives and canonical nodes remain separate metrics.
Each analysis took roughly 0.98–1.21 CPU seconds; capture, feature preparation and development overhead separate.
Different IDs imply different templates only in this fixed four-page cohort; this is not template classification.
An independent read-only audit rebuilt all 960 summary groups per condition with no mismatches.

entries.cohort: Same three held-out source-HTML targets, nested one/two same-site seed sets, MiniLM vectors reused.
limitations: Previously inspected, manually supplied templates; no optimal reference count established.
Four budget-exhausted tree outcomes for two references versus none for one; partial tree results remain separately classified.
Timing compares different run occasions, not paired latency repetitions.
No new inference. Absence behavior partly follows empty seed fields.

disposition: Deferred research on separate draft PR178; no immediate SDK implementation or further experiments.
